pages.text: A window that insulates like wool. Crafts four.

pages.title: Why
pages.text: Plain glass seals air but leaks heat.$(br2)Insulate the floor, walls and roof too. One window can't save a bare stone base.
Glass and packed ice with iron nuggets.$(br2)$(flavor)The ice doesn't melt. ORSA Physics is still arguing about why.$()
